# Test employees

The employees under `employees/` are made up for the tests of this repository and of the catalog's MCP server
(`harnesy/hr-mcp`), where they come from. They are not catalog employees and carry no text from hr.harnsy.dev: this
repository holds code only. They have the shapes the catalog has: no skills (`harnsy/sample-plain`), skills
(`harnsy/sample-skills`), skills with scripts and their licence (`harnsy/sample-scripts`), and an employee of another
publisher under CC0 (`octo/sample-guest`).

`golden/hermes/` is what the renderer must write for each of them: the same bytes the catalog's MCP server renders
for Hermes Agent.
